assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production diffuse albedo texture for the brown iris of a friendly storybook 3D game character. Generate ONE square, exceptionally detailed iris texture, straight-on orthographic, perfectly circular iris centered exactly in the image, iris touches all four image edges at their midpoints. Rich warm chestnut and amber brown, intricate irregular radial stromal fibers, a darker softly scalloped collarette around a pure black round central pupil whose radius is 38 percent of the iris radius, fine golden honey filaments, subtle broken concentric furrows and dark umber limbal ring. Corners outside the circle are uniformly dark umber. Flat diffuse color only, no baked illumination. NO specular highlights, NO white catchlights, NO reflections, NO sclera, NO eyelids, NO surrounding face, NO text, NO border. Must be usable as a UV-mapped albedo under a separately rendered transparent 3D cornea. Painterly realism, organic and richly varied, no perfect radial starburst or mechanical symmetry.
